faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Jammu Research Associate (RA) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the Research Associate (RA) position at IIT Jammu is 30th September 2026. Ensure you complete and submit your application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Ph.D. in a relevant or allied discipline. Additionally, a B.E./B.Tech. degree in Electronic Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), or Computer Engineering with Sensors Technology from a recognized university is required.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Associate (RA) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Associate (RA) position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST/OBC/women and physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive as per the provided information.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 49,000/- per month, along with HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate (RA) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate (RA) position at the Indian Institute of Technology Jammu.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate (RA) role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate (RA) position typically involves shortlisting of eligible candidates followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The position of Research Associate (RA) at IIT Jammu is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link is provided in the "Important Links" section of this article. It is recommended to download and read it carefully.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside Jammu and Kashmir apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the recruitment is open to eligible candidates. The location of IIT Jammu is Jammu, Jammu and Kashmir, but candidates from all eligible backgrounds can apply online.
